body:
hexagon: optimize CPY/CONCAT — round 3, short-rows edition ( #30341 )

hexagon: move the converting CPY in blocks of rows per DMA descriptor so short rows are not DMA-latency bound

hex-cpy: cleanup cpy cursor handling

hex-cpy-concat: introduce threaded dma/hvx gather-row helper

Co-authored-by: Ruslan Karymov 67752306+karusrus@users.noreply.github.com

hex-cpy: remove leftover rejections for extended buffers

hex-cpy: relax the gate for fast-path

hex-cpy: remove scalar divs and vtcm access and use explicit gather_sync

hex-cpy: add proper support for mdev work splitting to fastpath

hex-cpy: optimize dense gather-row tasks

hex-cpy: unroll gather-rows loops

hex-cpy: add fastpath for f16

hex-cpy-concat: support for colapsing 3/4D dims

hex-cpy: double-buffer support

hex-cpy: factor out gather-rows into more of an op by itself

hex-cpy-concat: dedup kernel-params

hex-cpy-concat: step-down nr to fit instead of hard fail

hex-gather: replace div with a mask

hex-gather-rows: cleanup dma pipeline and remove the stalls

hex-gather: specialize compute funcs

hex-gather: reduce scalar reg.spills and func calls

hex-gather: do not recompute rows-per-thread on the npu

hex-build: add support for building/installing just hexagon

hex-cpy-concat: remove redundant barrier in concat and move cpy barrier under fence

hex-gather: annotations for dma-out

hex-mdev: make all key vtcm_acquire sync state atomic (fixes random hangs in mdev setups)

Co-authored-by: Yiwei Shao yiwei@aizip.ai

summaryZh: llama.cpp项目近期提交了针对Hexagon NPU硬件架构的优化更新（第三轮短行优化），改进了复制与拼接操作（CPY/CONCAT）的DMA描述符块调度，并引入了多线程DMA/HVX聚集行辅助函数，有效避免了短行操作中的DMA延迟瓶颈。
